effect.name: Inner Shadow (Texture)
effect.description: This shaders adds an inner shadow.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo Inner Shadow (Texture) Shader | 2026.08.25 */
parameter.description: This shaders adds an inner shadow.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Offset in X-Axis
parameter.description: This variable specifies the offset along the X-axis.

parameter.name: Offset in Y-Axis
parameter.description: This variable specifies the offset along the Y-axis.

parameter.name: Size
parameter.description: This variable specifies the shadow size in pixels

parameter.name: (RGB) Shadow Color
parameter.description: This variable specifies the shadow color (RGB)

parameter.name: (RGB) Shadow Color Accent
parameter.description: This variable specifies the accent color of the shadow (RGB); it appears in the shadow's alpha color gradient (the lower the alpha value, the more prominent the color).

parameter.name: (Alpha) Shadow Color
parameter.description: Can mask or blend the color depending on whether the value is negative or positive.

parameter.name: Alpha Multiplier
parameter.description: Specifies the alpha multiplier for the shadow color; it can make the shadow sharper at high values (when greater than 1) or determine whether the shadow should be less visible when the value is between 0 and 1.

parameter.name: Alpha Base Multiplier
parameter.description: This variable specifies the alpha color multiplier for the base texture.
